newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - AUG 12.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - AUG 12.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Hungary's foreign trade deficit was $1.1 billion in the first half of 1997.
- Opposition parties Smallholders and Peasant's Union think that despite a good wheat crop producers will suffer from high storage costs.
- Mayor Gabor Demszky handed over personal documents aboput his opposition activity to Budapest's central Szabo Ervin library.
- Two Hungarian soccer teams face Danish opponents in today's European Cup matches.
- Hungarian television will not broadcast Wednesday's MTK-Trondheim soccer match following failed broadcasting fee negotiatins.
- Junior coalition partner Free Democrats are worried by the prospect of foreigners acquiring farmland in Hungary.
